pro_course_detail.title: The Sound of American English (Accent Reducction)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to master the unique sound of American English? In this course, The Sound of American English, we’ll dive deep into the specific sounds, rhythms, and intonations that define the American accent. Whether you're just beginning or looking to refine your existing skills, this course will help you speak with clarity and confidence, allowing you to sound more natural in conversations.

What You’ll Learn:
Distinct American Sounds: American English has its own set of vowels and consonants that are pronounced differently compared to other accents. We’ll work on these unique sounds, including the "r-colored" vowels, the flat "a," and others, to help you master the authentic American sound.
Rhythm and Intonation: American English is known for its rhythm and melody, with natural rises and falls in speech. You’ll learn to use intonation patterns that native speakers rely on to convey meaning, emotion, and emphasis.
Word Stress and Syllable Emphasis: Pronunciation is also about where you place the stress in a word. We’ll practice how to correctly stress syllables and words, which is key to sounding fluent and avoiding misunderstandings.
Common American Pronunciation Patterns: Many words in American English are shortened or connected in casual speech. We’ll explore these patterns, such as word linking and reductions (e.g., "gonna," "wanna"), to make your pronunciation more conversational and less formal.
Accent Reduction Techniques: If you’re looking to reduce your accent and adopt a more American sound, we’ll focus on techniques to help you speak more like a native. From practicing subtle changes in vowel and consonant sounds to perfecting rhythm and tone, you’ll learn how to sound more natural in American English.
Listening and Mimicking: A key part of learning pronunciation is listening to how native speakers talk.

Beginner to advanced learners of all ages are welcome! 

The lessons are adapted to your needs and interests. I use a variety of audiovisual materials and incorporate worksheets and homework that are specific for each student according to their needs and wants. If you need to refine your composition skills for work purposes, then the lessons will focus on reading and writing skills in accordance with writing conventions in a professional setting. If you simply want to improve your overall proficiency, then we will take a holistic approach and integrate all the skills into the lessons and post-lesson practice (homework!). In summary, the language learning plan is a collaborative process and is adapted according to the results that you wish to attain!

The first lesson / trial lesson serves as a diagnostic tool to help identify language gaps, specify preferences and interests, and discuss goals and how to best approach the lessons so that you may receive a more personalized learning experience that will help you achieve them. 

Lesson packages include a personalized learning plan, learning materials, writing assessments and feedback outside of lesson time, and a free speaking assessment after every 5 lessons. pro_course_detail.title: English Workshop: Reading, Writing, Speaking, & Listening [+Homework]
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for intermediate to advanced (B1-C2) English students who want to improve their skills in all aspects of language (reading, writing, listening, and speaking). This class is ideal for students who want to prepare for exams such as IELTS which include a writing section.

What will my lesson be like?

• Before our lesson, you will select and complete a homework assignment from my website. These assignments cover a wide range of topics and are based on authentic video material (news reports, TED Talks, interviews, etc.).  After watching the video, you will answer comprehension questions, complete vocabulary exercises, and write a 3+ paragraph essay on the topic. Homework is required and should be submitted at least a day before the lesson time. 

• During our Zoom meeting, we will analyze your essay and complete grammar/vocabulary exercises based completely on the errors in your essay. By using your essay as the basis of our lesson, I will be able to efficiently identify gaps in your knowledge and avoid wasting time on learning things you've already mastered.  After we finish working through your essay, we will continue discussing the topic in greater depth through an authentic text.

• Students will receive a password to access the homework platform before the lesson. An individual Google Doc with class notes & corrections will be sent to each student. 

[If you do NOT want to work on reading/writing or receive homework please choose "Informal Tutoring" instead. If the student does not submit an assignment before class, a "Guided Conversation" class will be taught instead. All classes are conducted on Zoom.]
